command: node --import apps/desktop/scripts/test-env.mjs --import apps/desktop/scripts/test-tsx.mjs benchmarks/rust-core/recorders/record-phone-plumbing.mjs --tree <git archive of b6f10295a2f698afc85332467192de28500bd146 with node_modules>

normalized.clientId: the replay opens the phone's relay leg as Node's recorded leg was named (client-a): the line names the relay client id's first 8 units
normalized.logDestination: Node's console.info ran in the desktop main process, which hosted the relay; the relay is the core's, so the line is the core's console.info, written as `[<ISO>] [console.info] <line>` to daemon.log (DaemonLog::console, as the rooms log): the replay compares the method and the line, not the time stamp
normalized.viewingOrder: Node's viewing is its visualizePanelSessionIds set in insertion order, the core publishes the set sorted: both are sorted before comparing (the replay and the Rust test). No page sees the order: the one reader of hostState.remoteViewing asks membership (apps/desktop/src/main/protocol/section-reads.ts visualizeRemoteViewing), as Node's viewsSessionLane answered one session at a time

notCompared.emptyBrowserId: a browser id '' is no push subscription's key (a subscription is keyed by the id the phone generated), so it is not asked

comparison.pushRule: the push columns ask legShowsSession of a live leg; Node's legacy leg rule (remote-relay-session-wiring.ts legacyLegShows: !background && screenSessionIds.has) is the same answer
comparison.replay: each step whole except the push columns: the call, the frames the phone received, the whole published hostState.remoteViewing value (read by a local connection once the phone has had an answer to a later request) against { sessionIds: Node's viewing }, and the PC's console lines so far (Node's pcLog against every `[console.<method>]` row the core wrote to <data>/daemon.log since the phone's first call); after the last step the core is stopped (which flushes its log) and the whole log is compared again
comparison.rustTest: credential, browser and viewing per step: mixdog-core-domains notify::screen::tests::the_phones_plumbing_calls_decide_what_nodes_relay_decided, on the core registry

entry.notRun: the relay transport (encryption, admission: the client's channel is set as the handshake leaves it) and the method table: none of these calls reaches it but remotePerfPaint, which has no id and is no method, so the empty table answers it as the full one does (executeRemoteFrame: no id, no answer)
entry.runs: createRelayClientCallDispatch (remote-relay-client-calls.ts) over a client state of createRelayClientRegistry (remote-relay-clients.ts), the paint probe tracker of shared/remote-performance.ts (perf flag off), clientViewsSessionLane and legShowsSession (remote-transport/foreground.ts)

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder
